 Paul Myerberg USA TODAY Nov. 16, 2026, 5:09 a.m. ET Hear this story Georgia remains the top-ranked team in the USA TODAY Sports NCAA Re-Rank 1-138.
 Ohio State has re-entered the top 15 following a significant Big Ten victory over Northwestern.
 The SEC dominates the rankings with 11 teams positioned within the top 35.
 Georgia stiff arms Utah to remain No. 1 in the USA TODAY Sports NCAA Re-Rank 1-138 while Ohio State climbs back into the top 15 after a netting a crucial Big Ten win against Northwestern .
 The re-rank has no changes near the top but dramatic changes begin after a static top 10, including multiple-spot jumps from the No. 15 Buckeyes, No. 14 Oregon and No. 13 Texas Tech.
 Thanks to losses by No. 16 Kentucky, No. 17 Southern California and No. 18 Houston, the Buckeyes are suddenly a stronger candidate for an at-large College Football Playoff bid.
 The Bulldogs didn’t break a sweat beating Missouri. While Utah had a better win on the road against Arizona, the Bulldogs maintain a solid edge in the chase for No. 1.
 HIGHS AND LOWS: Alabama leads college football Week 11 winners and losers One big factor in Georgia’s favor is the dominance of the SEC . The league has 11 of the top 35 teams in this week’s 1-138. One SEC team making a big leap in the re-rank is No. 27 Oklahoma, which is up 15 spots after beating Ole Miss .
 The middle third of the re-rank features double-digit slides by No. 40 Wisconsin, No. 43 James Madison, No. 44 Minnesota, No. 47 Clemson, No. 55 Pittsburgh and No. 60 Michigan.
 Still alive in the ACC race heading into Saturday, the Tigers lost 20-6 at home to Georgia Tech , triggering a 12-spot drop. Michigan was blown out by Oregon and dropped 13 spots.
